description: Outside MCP servers the Agentforce agents may call, registered in Agentforce Registry (Setup). Salesforce does not deploy or package a registration, so this file is the record of what each org must register by hand: docs/INSTALL.md step 11b has the clicks, docs/GUARDRAILS-AND-MCP.md the design. scripts/lib/mcp-probe.js checks every server here is reachable and still offers what we allowlist; test/config/esp32-mcp.test.js checks the agents and docs agree with it. To add a server: add an entry, allowlist only read-only tools, name the agents that may use it, and give the new subagent the same no-org-data rule.

auth.signIn: GitHub or WeChat account, once per user
